text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as summer training camp drew near—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "So, where are you taking me today?"
choice_data_list: You'll have to wait until we get there to find out.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh? What's that? Now I'm curious~♪
I'm gonna get my hopes up, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Loves Only You and I are heading
to a certain place together."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You had no idea.
About what was waiting for her at that place—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Whoa... That's so powerful...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...The place we arrived at was a massive event hall, characterized by walls and ceilings entirely covered in monitors.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It feels like I've stepped into another dimension.
...It's beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Still, why did you suddenly bring me to a place like this?
choice_data_list: I was introduced to it by Ms. Can't-Stick-To-Anything-For-Three-Days.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That's right! She knows so much
about these kinds of event venues, after all♪
choice_data_list: Don't you think it'd be amazing if we could stream from here?
Wouldn't it be amazing if we could stream from here?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! 
There's no way that wouldn't be totally fun!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what display style we could use.
If we could make it so comments completely fill up the screen, it'd get super hype...!
choice_data_list: Then let's give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Kya!? Wh-What!?

text_block_list.name: Chorus of Voices
text_block_list.text: “――――Ready, set, go!!”

text_block_list.name: Chorus of Voices
text_block_list.text: "Loves-chaaaaaaaan!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Huh—... Huh, what?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So many faces are popping up all over the place—
Wait, are these... all video calls!?

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Hellooo!
Can you hear me over there?
Can you see my face~?"
choice_data_list: Yes, I can see and hear you!

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Ah~, mic check, mic check." "Volume adjustment OK~"
"Once the test is done, please wait for further instructions~"
"Whoa~, what a sight!" "Is this on camera?"
choice_data_list: You're all in the shot too, you know!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-kun.
What is... this...!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, Trainer-chan.
What is this... !?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
With all these people on the monitors all around us,
what on earth is going on—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Online meeting applications,
which rapidly gained widespread use
alongside the infectious disease outbreak.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Making use of that, all the community members
who could make it gathered today.
——To let her know.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“No way—
Are all these people part of the community...?”

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"—Hello, Loves-chan.
I'm 'Three-Day Wonder Girl.'
...Yikes. Saying that out loud is so embarrassing."

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
""This is actually the first time I've shown my face and let you hear my voice like this, isn't it?
Thank you as always for all the love!""

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text: “I'm a middle-aged muscle-training guy. Haha, as you can see, I'm an old man, but I always enjoy your streams.”

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text: "Seeing how hard you work has given me so much energy every single day up until now. ...I'll always be cheering you on."

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"I am the Nori Roll King!" "I'm Mach Guitar!"
"I'm Syrup~!" "I am Azarashi Taro!"
"I'm Chocomallow!" "K-Ketchumayo here!"

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"I always watch your races!" "Fan for life!"
"Thanks for streaming, we love you!" "So glad to meet you!"
"Thank you for always making us smile!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Everyone...
Even though things must be so... tough right now...—
choice_data_list: That just shows how much everyone wanted to reach you.
That just shows how much everyone wanted to reach you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How much love Loves Only You had given me all this time.
How precious it was. And my gratitude for it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That we had already been deeply encouraged by Loves Only You.
And that was precisely why—
choice_data_list: ...Please tell me. Tell me what's weighing on your mind.
...Please tell me. Tell me what's weighing on your mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as she and the commu-members once helped me
shoulder my worries... this time, it's my turn
to bear them alongside the group.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Could it be that... everyone is doing all this for that reason...?
choice_data_list: Everyone was more than happy to gather here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It was precisely because Loves Only You shared so much love
and encouraged the Commu-members that everyone was able to gather together like this."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're just............ way too kind...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Even though... gh... I've received so much love... from everyone...!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't even cheer everyone up when they were suffering...!
Even though... I haven't been able to give back any love at all...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can say with absolute certainty: there's no way Loves Only You hasn't returned love.
Quite the opposite. She has always given more love to everyone than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And her community members gave back in kind.
Just like in Dubai, they supported her heart with love
time and time again, guiding her all the way here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because it is an era where connections have become hard to see,
she lost sight of it.
...The cycle of love that existed from the very beginning.
choice_data_list: We're all about helping and supporting each other with love... right?
We're all about helping and supporting each other with love... right?

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"That's right, Loves-chan!
You've already given us so much encouragement!
So this time, the fan community is going to give back!"

text_block_list.name: Hardworker@Overseas Assignment
text_block_list.text: "Times might get tough, and there'll be things beyond our control, but we can support each other! Just like we always have, and always will!"

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"As long as we're with you, Loves-chan,
we can fight together! No, we've ALWAYS fought together!
So please, don't push yourself all alone anymore!"

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Let's get through these times together!"
"I'm gonna give it my all starting today too!" "Solidarity!"
"Blowing off steam is important too!" "You're not alone!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ――...It's warm.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
...We already... were like that—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
…………Trainer-kun.
It seems I was mistaken all along—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
......Trainer-chan.
Without realizing it, I've had the wrong idea all along――

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I was just trying to save everyone... all on my own, completely one-sidedly...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
What we should truly be doing...
The form our love should take... isn't this...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: “—Hey, everyone! Listen up!!”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—I will surely spread my wings to the world once more...!
That is why I will keep running from here on...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
But this time, I won't try to fight alone...!
Cheering everyone on, trying to save them...
I won't do something so presumptuous ever again...!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fight alongside me...!
Let's share each other's pain and support one another...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"And for all the love everyone gives me...
I'll love everyone right back and run...!"

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: "WAAAAAAAAAAHHHHH!!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It has been spinning all along, right from the start...
Our love.
choice_data_list: Still, that feeling has grown even stronger now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Putting it into words, understanding each other,
and reconnecting, the love between her and the community members shone even brighter...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: For helping me realize my own unique strength.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, she moves forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Together with an even stronger love.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Beneath the summer sky leading toward our dreams—
